description: Prepare the audit environment for the Budget Tracker app that lives on origin/feature/budget-tracker (commit d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b), NOT main. Get the branch source into the working tree, install dependencies, and establish a static baseline (build + lint) capturing any compile/type/lint errors as the first QA findings. This feature leaves a running-capable app checkout and a documented baseline.
steps: Node is not on the default PATH. Run all node/npm commands through `bash -lc '...'` so nvm loads (Node v22.23.2). Verify with `bash -lc 'node --version && npm --version'`.

Bring the audited app into the working tree without disturbing main. Preferred: `git checkout -b qa-budget-tracker origin/feature/budget-tracker` in /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground. Confirm HEAD is at commit d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b with `git rev-parse HEAD`.

Install dependencies: `bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm install'`. Record any install warnings/peer-dependency errors (React 19 / lucide-react ^1.24.0 / recharts ^3 / tesseract.js ^7 version compatibility) as findings.

Run `bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm run build'`. Capture the full output. Any type errors, failed prerender of pages that call Supabase at build time, or missing-env-var failures are QA findings. Note that pages are client components but the root/landing may prerender.

Run `bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm run lint'`. Capture all eslint errors/warnings (e.g. next/image vs raw in scan page, missing alt text, react-hooks/exhaustive-deps on the useEffect(loadData, []) calls, use of `any`).

Note the absence of any .env.local / .env.example and that NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY are undefined. Attempt `npm run dev` in the background (`bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm run dev'`, run_in_background) and confirm the server starts and which port it binds. Record whether the landing page returns HTTP 200 (e.g. via curl http://localhost:3000).

Write a short baseline notes file at .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit-budget-tracker/baseline-notes.md summarizing: node version used, install result, build result (pass/fail + errors), lint result (list), dev server start status + port, and which env vars are missing. Record findings text in this feature file's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: Working tree is on the budget-tracker source (HEAD == d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b) and `ls app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx` succeeds.
`npm install` has completed; its result (success or the exact errors) is recorded.
`npm run build` and `npm run lint` have been run and their full outcomes recorded in baseline-notes.md and this feature's findings.
Dev server start attempt is documented with the bound port and whether http://localhost:3000 responds.
baseline-notes.md exists under the task directory.
verification: bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && git rev-parse HEAD' returns d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b
bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm run build' output is captured (pass or documented failure)
bash -lc 'cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground && npm run lint' output is captured
findings: Environment prepared successfully; full baseline in .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit-budget-tracker/baseline-notes.md. SOURCE: Checked out origin/feature/budget-tracker as local branch qa-budget-tracker. HEAD == d563b5edd90ab59e8c092bc456c64306110de97b (confirmed). App source present (app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx exists). main is only the stock create-next-app starter. No app source files modified (git status shows only untracked .agents/). TOOLCHAIN: Node v22.23.2 + npm 11.4.2 via nvm (bash -lc). Next.js 16.2.4 (Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind v4. npm install: SUCCESS, 489 packages, no peer-dep errors (React 19 / lucide-react / recharts ^3 / tesseract.js ^7 all resolved). npm audit reports 7 vulnerabilities (1 low, 6 high): next (many high advisories: middleware/proxy bypass, cache poisoning, XSS via CSP nonce, image-optimization DoS, SSRF via Server Actions/rewrites), brace-expansion (high DoS), js-yaml 4.0.0-4.3.0 (high DoS), nanoid <=3.3.17 (high), @babel/core <=7.29.0 (arbitrary file read), postcss (transitive). Fixes available via npm audit fix; not applied (setup-only). -> Security Findings. npm run build: SUCCESS. Compiled ~3.7s, TypeScript passed (0 type errors), 13 pages generated. Static: / /_not-found /budgets /dashboard /login /scan /settings /signup /transactions /transactions/new. Dynamic: /api/parse-receipt, /auth/callback + Proxy(Middleware). FINDING (low/warning): build + dev both emit 'The "middleware" file convention is deprecated. Please use "proxy" instead.' (Next 16.2.4). Build passes without Supabase env vars because client-component pages do not call Supabase during prerender. npm run lint: 0 errors, 1 warning. app/(app)/scan/page.tsx:234:13 @next/next/no-img-element (raw instead of next/image). No exhaustive-deps/no-explicit-any/alt errors from the configured flat config. dev server: STARTS on PORT 3000 (http://localhost:3000), Ready in ~291ms (Turbopack). CRITICAL runtime finding: with no Supabase env vars, EVERY route returns HTTP 500 (/ , /login, /signup, /dashboard all 500; /dashboard errors before its auth redirect). Root cause: middleware.ts matcher runs on ~all paths and updateSession (lib/supabase/middleware.ts:9) calls createServerClient(NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!) with undefined vars, throwing 'Your project's URL and Key are required to create a Supabase client!'. So even the public landing + auth pages are unreachable at runtime without credentials. Live functional/UI/a11y testing of the running app is BLOCKED pending real credentials -> do via code review in FEAT-002, do not mark passed. MISSING ENV VARS (expected, not fabricated): no .env.local and no .env.example on the branch. Undefined: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (auth + all CRUD), GEMINI_API_KEY (receipt AI parsing at /api/parse-receipt). Absence of .env.example is itself a setup/documentation finding.
